title: S5: Python call resolution on S3 and S4 (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a1)-(a8): call sites over S3 (module graph) and S4 (symbols): scopes and name lookup, known-class bindings per ruling 3, self/cls, MRO, super(), cls(...), the four call bins with exact counts over call expressions, a construction as two edges (class and resolved __init__ along the MRO), Q1-Q4 scoring conventions, polymorphic sites flagged not guessed. Ships unwired (S7 wires, S8 runs the gate). Rules per case are committed before the code (part 1 rules commit, part 2 for the four rulings Q1-Q4 of the S5 questions).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Rules per case are committed before the code and the rules commit SHA is recorded on this task before the first code commit
Every call expression outside ERROR regions falls in exactly one of the four bins and the four counts sum to the number of call expressions
A construction of an in-repository class is one site with two edges (the class and its resolved __init__ along the MRO, including an inherited __init__)
self, cls, known-class bindings (ruling 3), super() and cls(...) are attributed; self.x.m() and every receiver needing inference is counted unresolved, never guessed
The click 7.1.2 and requests ground-truth call sites resolve through the S6 scorer shape with the bin counts recorded by SHA (not the gate run)

implementationNotes: Rules commit part 1 (empty commit, rules per case 1-18, before any code): ea40d01c on branch feat/GCLI-81-python-calls (full SHA: ea40d01fd486ffd1bb28aaa03eac263b9402512a). Q1-Q4 (bin mapping into the index, multiply-bound callee, decorator with arguments, method only in an external base) were put to opum-doc via the leader as A/B and are NOT built until ruled; a part 2 rules commit will record the rulings before the code that handles them. Stated execution rules: caller innermost def with lambdas/comprehensions transparent, module and class-body callerId null, ERROR-region calls dropped and the file named, non-empty S3 exit7 carried to S7, polymorphic sites flagged not guessed.

Rules commit part 3 (empty, before the delta code): bea0b64bdc1f50b8a927240dc24e5f6a83739470 records DEC-303 (a11) verbatim and applies its one principle (a call resolves when Python's own static binding rules fix the target without type inference; it stays unresolved when the target depends on a run-time type) to every conservative reading of 3699733, rules 23-31, each with classification and reason; changed: local imports resolve (23), from-import of an external name as receiver is external (24), multiply-bound class alternatives get two edges each (25), first parameter of a method by decorator not by name (26), metaclass=type not a note trigger (29a), builtin yields to a partial or unknown star set (29b), literal receivers are external builtins (29c); kept: property calls (27), MRO failure (28), type(self)(...) (29d), rebound/parameter-bound names (29e), re-export alternatives (29f). Held-out misses were not read to decide any of these.

S5 delta code commit c42d80e8c31059b9efd73f5da90ee958fc2d9965 (rules part 3 bea0b64 precedes it): rules 23 (local imports resolve; one minimal exported S3 helper, modules.ts resolveLocalImportNode and ModuleResolver.resolveLocal), 24, 25, 26, 29a, 29b, 29c, with tests both ways, pins for 27, 28, 29d-g; one existing test changed (the literal receiver in the rule 6f test moves to resolvedExternal under 29c). bun run check 595 pass / 0 fail at c42d80e in a fresh frozen-install detached worktree (bun 1.3.14; CI pins 1.4.2). Bin counts at this head NOT recorded: the specialist was held-out-blind (no ground-truth reads, no scorer run) and check_call_sites.ts runs gate_score.py automatically when python3 exists; recording counts and the post-ruling click verdict is S8's, with the statement that the informational click run at 3699733 preceded DEC-303 (a11). Conservative readings chosen by the specialist: rule 24 alias of an external name stays unresolved; classmethod/staticmethod recognised only as the bare unshadowed name; @staticmethod on __new__/__init_subclass__/__class_getitem__ suppresses the implicit receiver; static+classmethod = static; metaclass=type matched syntactically; only direct literals are external (a parenthesized or negated literal stays unresolved); local-import resolution does not surface exit7; function-local star import skipped; a complete star set wins over a partial one; a multiply-bound class alternative is a full construction incl. notes; an outer method's receiver is reachable from a nested class method unless rebound.

Opus delta review of cffe3e5..c42d80e (claude-opus-5-5): BLOCK, 3 blocking: (1) rule 26 accepted a splat first parameter as the receiver, (2) rule 29b let a complete star import's re-export or assignment fall through to the builtin, (3) the 29b complete-set test passed on the pre-delta code. Non-blocking d and e (stale comment, missing tests) folded in. Design-level items routed to opum-doc by the leader and NOT changed: rule 26 width over non-static defs, uneven shadow handling (isUnshadowedBuiltin vs partial star, metaclass=type), class-body import flow-insensitivity. Rules commit part 4 (empty, before the fix code): 9f6094e5856fae4ac637d2b6cebf6e1a0084dba8 states corrected rules 32 and 33 and the owed tests (34).

Rules commit part 5 (empty, before the fix code): 98ded08de1b4ab7c993100abdba4303dc1eb6429 records DEC-303 (a12) verbatim (rule 26 width kept with two no-receiver shapes; one shadow rule for every builtin test; class-body imports order-aware) as rules 36-39 and supersedes rule 35 of part 4 (9f6094e). Fix delta code commit a6e7156ac486851183b1db3d497cc595b12fb41c implements rules 32, 33, 34, 36, 37, 38, 39: bun run check 627 pass / 0 fail at a6e7156 in a fresh frozen-install detached worktree (bun 1.3.14; CI pins 1.4.2); 16 new-rule tests fail on the pre-fix code (rule 32: 4, rule 33: 4, rule 36: 2, rule 37: 4, rule 38: 2) and 117 pass, with positive controls passing pre-fix as intended. Held-out blind: no ground truth read, no scorer run, bin counts not recorded. Known limitation (README, rule 36): a method wrapped by an opaque external non-property decorator is still attributed as a method. Specialist readings: several complete star sets with one name, the first import in file order wins; rule 36(i) the last class-scope binding kind decides; rule 36(ii) only bare callee or decorator names count as class-body uses; rule 38 covers call resolution, annotation and default lookups stay flow-insensitive.
